text.tspan: AKRA WEBAPP V2 - Flow Chart Workflow Diagram
Import into Figma/FigJam, ungroup, then edit node boxes/arrows/text directly.
Flow chart rule: diamond = decision; arrow label = branch; red node = Reject/blocked outcome; green rounded node = successful end state.
Source: docs/architecture/app-flow-diagrams.md plus latest V2 plan board status as of 2026-06-26. Node IDs are included so reviewers can name exact steps to change.
Implemented route selection flow. Permission checks decide what the user can open.
- Disallowed modules land in denied/queued state.
Implemented workflow. Cutover approval is separate from app behavior.
- LINE success/failure is an event only.
- Problem reports keep the current picking status.
- Sent requisitions reject new problem reports.
Planned write flow. Reject has a clear terminal path and does not create PO.
- Runtime PR write UI/RPC is not built.
- Reject path ends at PR rejected/closed.
Top row is current read-only UI. Bottom row is planned write workflow.
Top row is current read-only UI. Bottom row is planned receiving confirmation flow.
- Admin recall has a separate branch back to pending receiving.
Planned flow only. Duplicate requests and out-of-stock cases have explicit branches.
- Route is guarded; schema/workflow is not built.
Low-confidence placeholder. Reject ends at rejected/closed and skips warehouse processing.
- Approve path goes to warehouse processing.
Planned analytics flow from KPI mockup.
- Mockup exists; schema/runtime is not built.
- Below-target branch stays visible as a red metric state.
Import note: open the provided FigJam board, drag this SVG onto the canvas, then ungroup. Use step IDs like P9, PO12A, or GR14B when requesting workflow changes.
No production V1 app, GAS deployment, Sheet schema, URL, LINE token, Supabase schema, runtime code, or staging business data changed by this artifact.
